page.title: Activity
page.purpose: Show every spend attempt and let the operator reconstruct why each one resolved the way it did. Declines are first-class content here, because a decline is usually the system working.

priorities.statement: Every attempt appears, including the ones that were refused
The specific constraint that refused an attempt is named, not summarised
A settlement in the unknown state is the most visually urgent row on the page
Ledger emission status is visible so an unrecorded settlement is noticeable
An attempt's full decision path is reachable in one step

states.description: Attempts exist across approved, refused, declined, expired and unknown outcomes.
No spend has been attempted; the page says so rather than rendering an empty table.
Some attempts have unresolved ledger emission; the page distinguishes not-yet-emitted from failed-to-emit.
The view has not refreshed recently and states its age.
Evidence detail is operator-realm only; an agent-realm caller sees its own attempt outcomes and nothing else.

claims.statement: Refused and declined attempts are listed by default rather than behind a filter.
Each refusal names the specific constraint that refused it.
When any settlement is in the unknown state, resolving it is the page's dominant action.
Outcome is conveyed by text or shape in addition to colour.
Ledger emission status appears on each settled attempt.
The full decision path for an attempt is reachable in one interaction from its row.
